checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Two separate square images, not a collage
First image retains silhouette, matte black finish, lid details on plain white
must.why: Bottle shape and cap match closely; the finish looks slightly more rendered/glossy, with a faint gray shadow and smudges in the white.

must.item: No wooden table or original background in first image
must.why: Background is white; only faint gray haze remains.

must.item: Second image shows same bottle upright on rock by mountain lake with sunrise lighting
must.why: Bottle stands on a mossy rock by a misty lake, with warm sunrise glow on the mountains. The bottle is somewhat stockier, and the cap is a bit different.
No text visible in either image.

faults.what: In the first image the background is slightly off-white and blotchy with a faint gray cast, and the bottle looks slightly re-rendered with a changed perspective and a taller, narrower look.

In the second image the bottle is a re-creation: the cap is a little different and the proportions are slightly shorter and wider. The bottle is also backlit and dark, with little visible sunrise light on it.

summary: Both square images came out well: a clean white-background bottle that is a close match, and a realistic sunrise lake scene on a rock, with only minor bottle fidelity drift and a faint gray haze on the white.
